subject.title: fix(workboard): preserve proof history across later card writes

question: Should Workboard permanently expose the additive `proofView: "bounded"` and `workboard_proof_list` public API, rather than limiting this repair to lossless persistence and internal client loading behavior?
rationale: The central data-loss repair is well-scoped, but the branch also introduces a durable plugin-facing response mode, cursor contract, and tool surface that cannot be selected solely by correctness review.

options.title: Approve additive proof views
options.body: Keep the full-history default and accept bounded list/read views plus proof pagination as the supported public Workboard API.

options.title: Land persistence-only repair
options.body: Preserve proof in SQLite but remove or defer the new public bounded-view and pagination surface until separately designed.

options.title: Request a narrower API proposal
options.body: Pause this PR until the owner specifies the intended long-term Workboard proof retrieval contract and compatibility guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve additive proof views
recommendation.body: Keep the full-history default and accept bounded list/read views plus proof pagination as the supported public Workboard API.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged proof-lifecycle work and related report show direct ownership of the Workboard proof contract.
